facts.statement: In LateralHeaderDrawer.AppendInstance, a block piece whose BlockName is blank or not present in the active drawing's BlockTable is skipped without throwing: it is added once to the `missing` list (dedup key = BlockName ?? PieceId ?? Role, plus "|" + View) and the method returns false. No reference is created for it, and the rest of the plan keeps being drawn.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:293-303 (the comment at :302 says "skip rather than throw"); dedup set created per call at :33 (CreateSystemBlock) and :121 (RedefineSystemBlock)

facts.statement: CreateSystemBlock and RedefineSystemBlock return the skipped pieces as LateralHeaderDrawOutcome.MissingInstances. Neither method throws or aborts because of them.

On the creation path, SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock calls BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan before the drawing transaction. EnsureBlocks returns 0 without any user message in three cases: the library file does not exist, the library cannot be read (the read error is only logged), or a block is absent from the library. EnsureForPlan computes availability facts through LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow but returns only ImportedCount, so those facts are discarded.

Creating a Selective FRONTAL or PLANTA view does not fail because blocks are missing. ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace goes through BlockPlacement.PlaceAndReport, which builds HeaderPlacementResult(success: true, placed: <jig result>, ...) with MissingBlocks = DescribeMissing(...). Each line reads either "<name> (falta el bloque '<block>' en el dibujo)" or "<name> (sin bloque definido en blocks.csv para la vista <view>)".

facts.topic: 1. Missing library pieces (user report on insert)
facts.statement: On insert, the user is told on the command line. RackSelectivoCommands writes DescribeSelective(result) for planta and frontal, and RackCommandSupport.DescribePlacement adds "Bloques no definidos en el dibujo (omitidos): ..." when HasMissingBlocks. This happens only when the jig was accepted. If placement is cancelled, the message is only "creado, pero la insercion se cancelo" (no missing list), and the new definition is erased.

On the RACKEDITAR redraw path (EditSelective), missing blocks are not shown to the user. SystemBlockWriter.RedrawInPlace returns Success=true with MissingBlocks filled, but EditSelective checks only r.Success for frontal and planta, and its final summary does not mention missing blocks. No RackLog call exists for missing pieces either.

ProjectVariableMutationExecutor discards the LateralHeaderDrawOutcome returned by each view writer, which includes MissingInstances. Missing pieces during a variable propagation are therefore silent, and the mutation still commits.

The AUTH-15 in-transaction creator does not stay silent. RackDefinitionCreator.CreateInTransaction returns RackDefinitionCreationResult.Missing(...) when created.Outcome.HasMissingBlocks and does not write the envelope. It also performs no cleanup: whatever was written stays in the caller's transaction for rollback. No other file in src calls RackDefinitionCreator.

facts.statement: Some pieces are dropped inside the builders before the drawer runs, so they never appear in MissingInstances or in any message: planta largueros with no PLANTA blocks.csv row, planta separadores with no PLANTA row, frontal tarimas when TARIMA_GENERICA has no row for the view, any safety element whose block is missing for the view, and the planta celosía when its truss block is blank. By contrast, a frontal post, plate or larguero with no row keeps a blank BlockName, stays loose, and is reported by the drawer as 'sin bloque definido en blocks.csv'.

If the product catalog fails to load or loads empty, RackCatalogLoader.Load logs the problem and returns an empty or partial catalog. It never writes to the command line (the comment says it runs mid-draw). Drawing continues and pieces are omitted.

Selective FRONTAL (view "FRONTAL") parameters by piece: post LONGITUD (height) and PERALTE; base plate PERALTE, only when >0; larguero LONGITUD and PERALTE; lateral protector LONGITUD (= total fondo depth, only when >0); bota none; desviador LONGITUD; larguero tope LONGITUD and SAQUE (only with the TopeFrontal toggle); tarima LONGITUD and ALTURA (only with DrawPallets); parrilla FRENTE (only with the ParrillaFrontal toggle).

facts.topic: 3. Dynamic params - where they are applied
facts.statement: Parameters are applied only to references of catalog piece blocks. For grouped (ARRAY) pieces, that single reference lives inside the nested header definition. The references to the nested definitions themselves (SEL_FRONTAL_* / PLANTA_CAB_*) get only position and an optional X-mirror scale, never dynamic parameters. ApplyDynamicParameters matches names case-insensitively, skips non-dynamic references, and silently ignores names that are absent or read-only.
HeaderRunPlan and HeaderGroup are sealed classes, not records, with get-only properties typed IReadOnlyList<>. Their constructors store the caller's list references without copying.

The FRONTAL plan comes from HeaderInstanceGrouper.Group. At runtime, Headers and LooseInstances are List<T>. Each HeaderGroup.Instances is a one-element array (new[] { local }) and each Placements is a List<HeaderPlacement> from ToList(). All of these are mutable underneath the IReadOnlyList interface. Loose instances are the same objects that Build() created (no copy).

In the PLANTA plan, Headers is a List<HeaderGroup> (ToList) and LooseInstances is a List<HeaderBlockInstance>. Each HeaderGroup.Instances is the builder's List<HeaderBlockInstance>, and each Placements is the same live List<HeaderPlacement> the builder appended to; ToGroup passes it without copying.

HeaderBlockInstance is a sealed class with public setters on Role, PieceId, BlockName, View, Insertion, ConnectionAnchor, RotationRadians, MirroredX, MirroredY, Text, TextHeight, DimensionOffset and DimensionStyleName. DynamicParameters is a get-only property that returns a mutable Dictionary<string,double>. HeaderPlacement and Point2D are readonly structs with get-only properties, so they are immutable. The plan types contain no C# records.
PreparedViewRedraw keeps the same HeaderRunPlan object (and the same shared RackCatalog) from PREPARE through MUTATE, with get-only properties and no defensive copy. The objects it holds are mutable.

facts.topic: 5. Nested block naming - requested names restart per plan
facts.statement: FRONTAL nested-group names are "SEL_FRONTAL_" + Role + "_" + groupIndex. groupIndex is a local counter that restarts at 0 on every Group call and counts only buckets of 2 or more. PLANTA nested-group names are "PLANTA_CAB_" + (groups.Count + 1), where `groups` is a new local list per BuildPlan call. So every plan asks for the same base names (SEL_FRONTAL_Post_0, PLANTA_CAB_1, ...).

Effective names come from UniqueBlockName, called for every nested header definition and for the new system block. It sanitizes the name, then returns the first of name, name_1, name_2, ... not already in the BlockTable at the moment of the call. The effective name therefore depends on what the table already holds, which includes earlier racks' SEL_FRONTAL_* or PLANTA_CAB_* definitions and unpurged stale ones. It depends on creation order.

facts.topic: 5. Nested block naming - multi-view single transaction
facts.statement: ProjectVariableMutationExecutor redefines every prepared view (several frontals, lateral cortes and planta) inside one transaction, in view-scan order. The old nested definitions are only collected as stale and purged after the commit. While the transaction runs, each redefine requests base names that the previous definitions still occupy. The code comment confirms that redefines produce uniquified names (nombre_1, _2…).

The static code cannot prove that BlockTable.Has sees a record added earlier in the same uncommitted transaction (blockTable.Add at :244 before later UniqueBlockName calls). If it does, which is standard AutoCAD behavior and consistent with the code comment at :94-96, a second frontal created or redefined in the same transaction receives _1/_2 suffixed nested names, and the order it was processed in decides the suffixes. This includes several calls to AUTH-15 CreateInTransaction within one caller transaction.

facts.topic: 5. Nested block naming - normal create path
facts.statement: On the normal insert path, each view is created in its own transaction (SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock opens and commits one transaction per view). One transaction therefore never creates several frontals there. Names still depend on what earlier commands left in the table.

The planta selection in EditSelective is every rack block definition that FindRackBlocks returns (matched by GUID over all definitions) and whose decoded address kind is Planta. The count is unbounded (0..N). No user choice, prompt or index is involved, and the loop at :235-244 redraws all of them.

Every selected planta block is redrawn with the whole `system`, not a per-fondo view, and with payload section -1 (WrapSelectivePayload default). Planta blocks get no availability/stale check (frontals get one at :173-180, laterals at :210-217), so they always count as survivors. The comment "one block for the whole top view" is not enforced: the insert path adds a new planta block without checking for an existing one.
The defensive fallback that adds the clicked block when the GUID scan misses it adds it only to frontalBlocks, never to plantaBlocks.

The function that extracts a plan's library requirement set is RackBlockRequirementExtractors.HeaderRun.Extract(HeaderRunPlan). It collects the BlockName of every LooseInstance and every Headers[*].Instances item, skips blank names, and de-duplicates case-insensitively. Production use: BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan. A V2 per-piece extractor also exists: RackHeaderPieceRequirementExtractorV2.Extract(plan, address), projected by LibraryPieceKeyProjection.Project and wired through RackViewPreparationAdapter.PrepareV2. No production call site in src/RackCad.Plugin uses RackViewPreparationAdapter.

Block names resolve through blocks.csv: FindBlock takes the first row whose pieceId and view match case-insensitively, and uses its blockName. FRONTAL uses view token "FRONTAL" (SelectiveRackDefaults.View); PLANTA uses "PLANTA".

With the shipped catalogs, the FRONTAL plan can require only these blocks.csv names. Always, for a rack with height and bays: POSTE_OMEGA_ATORNILLABLE_CON_TROQUEL_GOTA_DE_AGUA_FRONTAL (system.PostId; the only POSTE row in secciones.csv) and, when DrawBasePlate is on, PLACA_BASE_DE_CABECERA_ATORNILLABLE_DE_PLACA_CALIBRE_3_16_FRONTAL. Per level beam id: LARGUERO_ESCALON_CAL14_3_REMACHES_FRONTAL, LARGUERO_IN_OUT_C6_FRONTAL, LARGUERO_ESCALON_INFINITO_FRONTAL, LARGUERO_ESCALON_TROQUEL_REDONDO_FRONTAL. BOTA: PROTECTOR_BOTA_H_3_16_18_FRONTAL, PROTECTOR_BOTA_C_4_FRONTAL, PROTECTOR_BOTA_C_6_FRONTAL. LATERAL: PROTECTOR_LATERAL_BOTA_H_3_16_18_FRONTAL, PROTECTOR_LATERAL_BOTA_C_4_FRONTAL, PROTECTOR_LATERAL_BOTA_C_6_FRONTAL. The frontal code never references MENSULA_*, TRAVESANO_*, SEPARADOR_*, GUIA_ENTRADA or DEFENSA_MONTACARGAS.

facts.statement: blocks-library.dwg is not tracked in the repository at 3375aadb. The Plugin csproj would copy assets/catalogs/*.dwg, but none exists. The library path used at runtime is the user settings override, or catalogs/blocks-library.dwg next to the assembly. Whether the required names are actually present in the library cannot be decided statically.

BlockLibraryDatabaseCache is a process-wide, single-slot static cache guarded by a static lock. It holds one parsed side Database (read with ReadDwgFile, OpenForReadAndAllShare), keyed by (path compared OrdinalIgnoreCase, FileInfo.LastWriteTimeUtc, FileInfo.Length). A different key replaces and disposes the previous Database. A read failure is logged and returns null without caching.

AutoCadLibraryBlockQuery (V1, active drawing) has no static state; it holds only an instance Database field. AutoCadExternalLibraryBlockQuery has no static fields of its own, but it reads through the static BlockLibraryDatabaseCache.Acquire(BlockLibraryLocator.ResolvePath()). No `new AutoCadExternalLibraryBlockQuery` appears in src. The extractor singletons (RackBlockRequirementExtractors.HeaderRun, RackHeaderPieceRequirementExtractorV2.Instance) are static but stateless.

JsonRackCatalogProvider keeps a process-wide static ConcurrentDictionary<string, CacheEntry{Signature, Catalog}>. The key is the catalog directory path (OrdinalIgnoreCase), with a per-entry lock. An entry is reused only when its signature matches. The signature is the sorted list of Name|Length|LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks for every *.csv and *.json directly in the directory; it is "<missing>" if the directory does not exist and a new GUID on stat failure, which in effect disables reuse. The cached RackCatalog instance is shared across callers even though it has public setters; only a comment requires read-only use. The signature does not cover blocks-library.dwg or settings.json.

facts.topic: 8. Static caches - RackCatalogLoader and path resolvers
facts.statement: RackCatalogLoader has no static fields and delegates to JsonRackCatalogProvider.FromBaseDirectory().Load(), so it inherits the provider's cache. CatalogDirectory.Resolve, BlockLibraryLocator.ResolvePath and UserSettingsStore.Load keep no cache and recompute or re-read on every call. UserSettingsStore reads settings.json from disk each time.

facts.topic: 8. Static state on the planta PREPARE path (not a cache)
facts.statement: SelectivePlantaBuilder.BuildPlan reads RackFrameTemplateCatalog.All, a static built-in template list initialized once, with no key and no invalidation. It is static data, not a file-backed cache.

facts.topic: 8. Other static caches outside the candidates
facts.statement: CsvStructuralSectionCatalogProvider has its own static ConcurrentDictionary cache (keyed by directory, invalidated by signature). None of the four candidates, nor the Selective frontal/planta builders, reach it; its users are StructuralSectionCatalogAccess and the Cantilever window.

limitations: Static, read-only analysis at 3375aadb only. Nothing was built, run or tested, and AutoCAD runtime behavior was not observed.

AutoCAD API semantics were not verified from the repository: BlockTable.Has seeing uncommitted additions, DynamicBlockReferenceProperty behavior, and whether Database.Purge filters correctly. F5.4 is UNCERTAIN for this reason.

The required-block-name sets in item 7 depend on the design (post, plate and beam ids per level, safety selections, toggles, custom cabeceras, fondo count), so only the reachable universe and a minimal default set could be derived. The runtime catalogs folder is a deployed copy that may differ from assets/catalogs.
blocks-library.dwg is not in the repository, so whether the required names exist in the library cannot be established statically.
SHA-256 values are of the raw git blobs (git show 3375aadb:<path> | sha256sum). A checked-out or deployed file with different line endings would hash differently.

missed.statement: When a grouped (ARRAY) piece has a non-blank block name that is absent from the drawing, the drawer still creates its nested definition (SEL_FRONTAL_* / PLANTA_CAB_*), leaves it empty or partial, and still appends and counts a reference to it at every placement. InsertedCount (the 'N piezas' figure in DescribePlacement) therefore includes references to empty nested definitions. Both create and redefine behave this way.

missed.statement: Planta and frontal grouping use different thresholds. The frontal nests only signature buckets with 2 or more identical instances; single pieces stay loose. The planta creates a nested PLANTA_CAB_n definition for every distinct frame, even one placed only once, and always for each custom cabecera. So the planta always creates nested definitions whose names are subject to UniqueBlockName.

The project-variable batch path (ProjectVariableMutationExecutor) also picks up every planta view of the rack by GUID and address kind, with no availability or orphan check (the check is gated with !isPlanta). It redraws each one with the whole system and section -1, in the same single transaction as the frontals and laterals.

The static JsonRackCatalogProvider cache is shared beyond the Plugin loader. The UI (UiSupport) and RackFrameConfigurationFactory's parameterless constructor also call FromBaseDirectory().Load(). While the folder signature is unchanged, the editor window and Plugin PREPARE (RackCatalogLoader) therefore receive the same mutable RackCatalog instance.

On the planta PREPARE path, RackFrameConfigurationFactory.Build throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the resolved height or a fondo depth is <= 0. That is a hard creation failure, so DrawAndPlace returns Failure and the mutation executor aborts. This differs from the silent skip applied to missing blocks.

At the bound commit 3375aadb, the AUTH-15 Precheck still rejects an envelope with a blank Name (InvalidEnvelope). This check runs before any write or missing-block evaluation. The later C1 relaxation (merge 1304101d) is not part of 3375aadb.
